findings.finding: the canonical router dependency for AipMemoryGovernanceService returns None, so approve and promote fail closed with 503 in the production wiring despite complete service and unit-test implementations.
the canonical retrieval dependency returns None, so KnowledgeQuery is not available through the production API.
the canonical search dependency returns None, so KnowledgeSearch remains unavailable and readiness must report the provider gap.
production wiring requires trusted artifact, license, payload, index and governance authority resolvers; test doubles cannot be promoted into runtime evidence.
no current org-org/dev-project positive sample was read in this task, so candidate, memory, query and citation readiness for the real tenant is unverified.

the generic Memory Governance page provides read-only candidates, memories, events, query and pipeline views, but the eight Workshop modules do not yet have context-scoped governance projections or safe deep links.

decisions: retain AIP-5 MemoryCandidate, CandidateEvent, MemoryItemRevision, KnowledgeQuery and KnowledgeCitation as the only authorities
candidate submission remains owned by trusted knowledge pipelines or evidence-backed EffectReview and Observation flows; Workshop must not expose an ungoverned submit form
wire governance, retrieval and search only with trusted exact resolvers and keep the current 503 fail-closed behavior until all dependencies are available
use KnowledgeReadiness as an explicit Workshop gate and never infer readiness from service classes or passing unit tests
Workshop modules may deep-link to the generic governance authority using exact candidate, memory or subject context, but must not duplicate approval or promotion state
verify org-org/dev-project candidates, memories, readiness and a complete citation query through read-only browser and API evidence before enabling W4-05 UI

verification.interpretation: authority, policy and fail-closed contracts are stable under tests; production provider wiring and real-tenant readiness remain unproven

nextGate: AIP-5 must wire trusted governance, retrieval and search providers and prove org-org/dev-project readiness before Workshop W4-05 implementation can be authorized.
